short_description: Non-canonical FirstPersonEmbodiment prototype layered on the accepted CH9.6 character, clothing, Item Graph and ENet presentation stack.
purpose: Evaluate first-person hands, clothing-visible viewmodels, independent left/right grip UX and network-state projection without reopening or mutating the frozen CH9.6 checkpoint and without claiming item/network authority.
expected_outcome: A separate research lab can render two first-person hands, mirror the server-backed selected hotbar item, project upper clothing into first person, exercise local-only grab targets, and fail closed for canonical world-item grabbing until an explicit hand authority contract is authorized.
current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix5.1 — restore graphical FPE load and make performance gate deterministic
progress_note: The dedicated detached FPE worktree reached a clean Fix4.1 focused pass on Windows Godot 4.7.1 stable double a13da4feb: class-cache preflight PASS, FirstPersonEmbodiment contract PASS 23 assertions, nonblocking hotbar adapter PASS 17 assertions, and graphical scene-load PASS 5 assertions. PLAY still exhibited severe continuous frame hitching in an otherwise trivial scene. Fix5 isolated two 60 Hz CPU/main-thread churn paths and added a throttled CH9.6 research host plus dirty/event-driven FPE equipment/hotbar synchronization. The first operator Fix5 run exposed two validation defects before performance could be accepted. First, test_first_person_embodiment_performance_gate added the full CH9.6 host to SceneTree, so accepted _ready() calls incremented status counters before the synthetic 180-call burst and also triggered the known optional Male_Peasant.gltf fallback errors; the gate therefore compared absolute counters against a nonzero baseline. Second, quaternius_first_person_embodiment_lab.gd used inferred typing for hotbar_pending even though hotbar_network_adapter is dynamically typed, producing a Godot parse error. Because the FPE root script failed to bind, PLAY displayed only its CH9.6 child in third person, which explains the operator screenshot with no first-person hands. Fix5.1 makes hotbar/HUD locals explicitly typed, makes the performance gate instantiate the host without adding it to SceneTree so the throttle is tested in isolation, and upgrades PLAY_FPE_RESEARCH.ps1 with an exact headless FPE graphical scene-load gate after class-cache refresh. PLAY can no longer report preflight PASS and silently fall through to a child lab when the FPE root script has a parse/compile regression. Accepted CH9.6 remains untouched.
